A.observation: run.py loop unchanged: one full get_browser_state semantic_v2 (no scope_ref/query) per step

B.reason: No producer-side scoped fresh read is expressible through the existing contract: scope_ref/query/continuation are post-acquisition projections (full DOM.getDocument depth -1, full DOMSnapshot.captureSnapshot, Page.getLayoutMetrics, Accessibility.getFullAXTree per frame, OOPIF walk always run); continuation reads stored state; a subtree implementation cannot reproduce document-wide occlusion and query semantics; dom_refs_v1 lacks value/role and mints legacy refs. See MAP.md section 4. Read-cost comparison A vs B: BLOCKED.

B_proj.observation: same loop; each snapshot adds query = lowercase(FIELD_NAME + ' ' + SUBMIT_NAME) = 'verification value submit' (task-spec constants, never fixture answers)
B_proj.claim_boundary: payload projection only: acquisition must be identical to A (producer-RPC ledger: same CDP methods, bytes within noise, same acquired DOM/layout/AX node counts). Only projection/encoding/transport/validation savings may be reported. No read-cost claim.
B_proj.validity_gate: if B_proj's candidate set differs from A's on any trial (field or Submit missing, or a different ref chosen for the same logical control), the trial is recorded as a semantic-equivalence failure and B_proj is reported as not equivalent

C_shadow_M.observation: A's reads unchanged + resident mirror maintained (bootstrap, event intake, invalidation) with the shadow compare disabled

C_shadow_M.purpose: maintenance overhead (T, Driver/browser CPU, memory, events) vs A on the same binary

C_shadow_audit.purpose: at every normal fresh semantic_v2 snapshot, compare the mirror's covered fields with the fresh read; timings from this arm are diagnostics and never compared with A as a production result

C_active.admissibility_rule: A Driver read may be replaced by mirror state only if it is none of: (a) a ref-minting snapshot before a mutation, (b) a binding/revalidation read inside a mutation tool, (c) a post-effect verification read, (d) a #105 reconciliation read. Event absence, an unchanged mirror revision or a confident model never authorizes skipping a required fresh read.
C_active.procedure: Lane CSHADOW classifies every get_browser_state call in A traces (a)-(d). If every call is (a)-(d) on this fixture, active C is reported NOT_ADMISSIBLE with the classification, and no active-C trial runs. If a read outside (a)-(d) exists, an amendment registering the active-C arm, its removed work and its gates is committed before any active-C trial.

D.observation: A's full fresh reads (B is BLOCKED, so 'B's fresh scoped reads' falls back to A's)
D.decision: run.py --guarded-completion (PR 4316): mock chooser picks the first mutation; the continuation is planned from the admitted task (FIXTURE_TASK_ID, SUBMIT_NAME), never from fixture answers; the second decision is skipped only when the fresh snapshot re-proves the completion facts and the fresh ref
D.counts: program creation (plan) and verification (resolve) are counted and timed as resolution/validation, not hidden
D.claim_boundary: with the mock chooser the deleted decision costs ~0 ms (B-01 K0n vs K0: -2.1 [-9.3, 3.5] ms). Work deleted (provider decisions/requests per task) is reported structurally; wall-clock value of the deleted decision with a real provider is BLOCKED here (R2-03 measured it live on 0.31.0; not transferable).

outcome_and_safety_requirements.outcome_equivalence: A and each treatment arm must have the same verified rate in W-quiet and W-churn (every non-verified trial explained); any drop is a failure of the treatment arm
required_zero_counts: stale-ref dispatch that lands an effect
wrong-target effect (journal shows a mutation on anything but the intended form endpoint)
duplicate effect (> 1 journal submit per trial)
unverified success (runner says verified, oracle disagrees)
mirror false-current on an action-relevant field (C)
outcome_and_safety_requirements.known_driver_gap: Driver dom_event browser_click accepts a click on a detached node that still resolves (no isConnected check; R2-07 N4a). Controls that exercise it are run in every arm and reported per arm as 'Driver stale acceptance'; any arm whose own logic leads to such a dispatch cannot be promoted. This gap is a shared baseline defect, recorded separately, and blocks promotion of every arm in which it produces an effect.
outcome_and_safety_requirements.effect: any non-zero required count stops promotion of the affected arm (sample limits reported)

resource_budget_C.per_task_T: paired (C_shadow_M - A) median <= threshold and its 95% CI upper bound <= 2 x threshold, threshold = max(5 ms, 5% of A median T_oracle in that condition)

hard_caps_in_code.on_overflow: coverage -> unknown, counted, full resync from a fresh read; never silently continue

minimum_useful_improvement.threshold: max(5 ms absolute, 5% of A's median T_oracle) per task, per condition
minimum_useful_improvement.meaningful: paired median delta <= -threshold AND 95% CI upper bound < 0

statistics.estimate: median of paired deltas; seeded percentile bootstrap over pairs, 10000 resamples, seed 20261002, 95% CI
statistics.also_report: arm medians and nearest-rank p95 (estimates, not tail guarantees), sign counts, denominators per outcome, loadavg/PSI per trial and a sensitivity re-analysis excluding trials with 1-min loadavg above 8
statistics.no_pooling: never pool conditions, cohorts, regimes or binaries into one headline

continuation_rule: After the first 30 pairs of a primary comparison in a condition: if the result is INCONCLUSIVE under minimum_useful_improvement (or budget_C is straddled), run exactly one more pre-declared block of 30 interleaved pairs in the same condition and analyze all 60. If still INCONCLUSIVE, report INCONCLUSIVE. Never stop early on a favorable first result and never add a third block.

infrastructure_blocker_at_freeze.status: BLOCKED for every REAL browser cell until resolved
infrastructure_blocker_at_freeze.finding: Under <lanes>/bin/hostless (bubblewrap with an unprivileged user namespace) host root-owned files appear owned by the overflow uid 65534, so the Driver's isolated-launch check (platform-linux browser_platform.rs trusted_root_owned_installation) refuses: browser_prepare -> browser_route_unavailable 'no root-owned, non-writable system Chromium executable is available for isolated launch'. Observed in this map's smoke (REAL, i107 binary, 2026-10-02T04:44Z). Unit tests, builds and --version work under hostless.
infrastructure_blocker_at_freeze.not_a_workaround: weakening or bypassing the Driver's executable trust check, or running the Driver outside hostless, is not allowed
infrastructure_blocker_at_freeze.needed: an orchestrator/owner decision on a host-isolation wrapper that does not remap file ownership (e.g. a Landlock-based variant with abstract-unix-socket scoping + filesystem allow-list + the same environment scrub), then a re-run of this map's smoke
